title: QR Studio – Scan & Create QR
description:
Full description:

QR Studio is a fast, powerful QR Code Scanner and QR Code Generator built for everyday use. Scan QR codes instantly, create custom QR codes, and manage everything with smart history and collections — all in one modern app.

If you're looking for a reliable QR scanner, QR reader, or QR maker, QR Studio gives you speed, simplicity, and full control.

🔍 FAST QR CODE SCANNER
• Real-time QR code scanning
• Scan QR code from camera or gallery
• WiFi QR scanner with instant connect option
• UPI QR scanner with quick payment support
• Smart QR reader with automatic content detection
• Flashlight support for low light environments

🎯 SMART QR READER ACTIONS
QR Studio automatically detects QR type and shows relevant actions:
• Open website links
• Connect to WiFi networks
• Make UPI payments
• Call phone numbers
• Send SMS messages
• Save contact cards (vCard)
• Compose emails

📂 QR HISTORY & COLLECTIONS
• Automatically saves scanned and generated QR codes
• Organize with custom collections
• Add one QR code to multiple collections
• Full-text search
• Filter by collection
• Swipe to delete with Undo
• Storage limit indicator (Free & Pro)

🎨 QR CODE GENERATOR & QR MAKER
Create QR codes for:
• Website (URL)
• WiFi network (SSID & password)
• Email
• Phone number
• SMS
• Contact card
• UPI payment
• Plain text

Customize your QR code design:
• Foreground & background colors
• Logo overlay (Pro)
• High-resolution QR code export
• Save to gallery
• Share QR image instantly

Whether you need a QR code generator for business, a WiFi QR maker for home, or a simple QR scanner app for daily use, QR Studio makes it easy.

🔐 PRIVATE & OFFLINE
• Works completely offline
• No unnecessary permissions
• Your QR code data stays on your device

⭐ PRO VERSION
• Ad-free QR scanner experience
• Unlimited scan history
• Unlimited collections
• Custom QR colors & logo branding
• Priority support

QR Studio is your all-in-one QR code scanner, QR reader, and QR code generator.

Download QR Studio today and scan, create, and organize QR codes effortlessly.
